request.prompt:
Polish this desert map chunk into a coherent top-down / slightly 2.5D painted RPG ground
background, modern high-end pixel-art / painted hybrid, finished game-art quality. The input
is an upscaled section of a larger map, soft and blurred from enlargement; repaint it sharp
and richly textured.

Treat the input image as the exact production layout, not a loose concept sketch. Preserve the
layout exactly: every shape, structure, rock formation and terrain marking stays in the same
place, at the same size, with the same silhouette. Unusual or surprising shapes are deliberate
-- preserve them exactly as they are; do not reinterpret them as something else. Do not invent
or add any new structures, objects, or terrain features. Do not remove or relocate anything.
Where the input shows plain sand, output plain sand. Improve only the rendering: sharpness,
sand grain, stone texture, weathering, subtle palette variation.

Maintain edge continuity with the neighboring chunks of the same map. Top-down, even lighting,
no cast shadows. No text, labels, UI, grid lines, characters, or creatures.

Image 1 is the map chunk to redraw. Image 2 is the FULL map with this chunk's location outlined in magenta, for orientation only: use it to understand what the partial shapes in image 1 belong to (a corner of a large structure, part of a larger formation, and so on). Do not copy content, framing, or scale from image 2. Redraw image 1 only, keeping its layout exactly.

The remaining images are the adjoining map chunks (image 3 = the east neighbour, image 4 = the south neighbour). Use them ONLY for continuity across the shared edge: match their colour, tone, brightness and texture density so the chunks read as one continuous painting, and carry any feature that crosses the border straight through. Do NOT copy a neighbour's composition or content into this chunk -- image 1's layout is what you redraw.

Chunk ID: chunk_00_00
Preserve the input layout exactly while improving painted terrain detail.
